title: 第14章  杀人放火金腰带，扎纸成灵
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
与此同时。
谢剑经过申请，进入青云宗内门，蛇首峰。
进入蛇首峰后。
轻车熟路来到背山。
找到一个山洞。
顺着石阶一步步往下。
四周空气越来越粘稠，带着血腥味。
墙壁上镶嵌的是骷髅头，空洞的眼眶，仿佛注视着每一个入侵者。
石阶的尽头是一方翻滚的血池。
“咕嘟……”
“咕嘟……”
血水粘稠如浆，时不时冒出气泡，炸裂开来，溅起红色雾气。隐约可见几具尚未完全融化的森白骨架在池中沉浮。
这一幕显得非常恐怖。
谢剑走到血池边，【扑通】一声双膝跪地，额头贴在冰冷滑腻的石砖上。
颤颤巍巍的开口：
“大大人。”
“出事了。”
“沈公子死了。”
血池中血水翻滚的动作猛地一滞。
片刻后。

一只由鲜血凝聚而成的巨大手掌，缓缓从池中心探出，虚握在半空。
嘶哑的声音就在空旷的地下回荡。
“合欢宗的小崽子，死了便死了。”
“那是他学艺不精，怪不得别人。”
血池的声音冷漠至极。
谢剑：“可是合欢宗的人追究起来怎么办？”
血池：“我会帮你解释的。”
谢剑闻言，紧绷的神经才稍微放松一些，不知何时，后背的冷汗，早已浸透了锦袍。
原本他以为大人会因为沈公子之死而迁怒于他的。
毕竟沈醉是和合欢宗沟通的桥梁。
没想到大人竟然那么通情达理。
紧接着。
那血色大手突然溃散，化作漫天血雨，声音陡然转冷：
“不过……”
“在安置区这种只有老弱病残的地方，你都连续折损我的人手。”
“我不得不怀疑你的能力了。”
“如果你无法完成我的计划的话，我不介意换一个代理人。”
血池的声音，恍若地狱一般冰冷。
谢剑闻言，额头上又禁不住大汗淋漓，浑身不断颤抖。
砰砰砰！

谢剑低下头。
对着血池连续扣了九个响头。
“求大人再给我一次机会。”
“我一定完成得漂漂亮亮的。”
“而且……”
“安置区连连折损人手，是因为里面有隐藏的筑基高手。”
谢剑前半句求饶，后半句为解释。
血池翻滚了一会，忽然在谢剑前方，形成一只巨大的红色眼睛，冰冷，且恐怖。
“我可以给你最后一次机会。”
“而且会给你足以击杀筑基修士的道具。”
“如果最后你还是完不成的话，后果你是知道的。”
谢剑跪服在地，声音激动：
“谢大人。”
“我保证能完成的。”
“希望如此吧！”血池说着，血水不断翻滚，随后两道流光从血池深处飞出，悬浮在谢剑面前。
一枚猩红如血的玉简。
一面刻满狰狞鬼脸的黑色罗盘。
“这两件道具。”
“玉简封印了本座的一道【血煞神光】，可杀金丹初期，触之必死。”
“罗盘乃是【寻灵盘】，可探查方圆三里内的气血和灵力波动。只要那位隐藏的修士，没有达到金丹期，就躲不过查探。”

“谢大人。”
谢剑伸出颤抖着双手，接过两样道具。
有了这两样底牌。
他就有信心镇压安置区了。
“不用谢我。”
“这两样东西不是白给你的。”
“有两个任务。”
“第一：彻底掌控安置区。将那个隐藏的老鼠揪出来。”
“第二：我要十对有灵根的男婴女婴。”
“若是办不到……”
“你这一身筑基后期的血肉，就用来填我的血池吧。”
谢剑吓得魂飞魄散，疯狂磕头，额头撞击地面发出【砰砰】的闷响，鲜血直流：
“属下遵命。”
“一定办到。”
“滚吧。”
血池中那位大人说完这句话之后，顿时沉寂了下去，再无波澜。
谢剑则对着血池，恭敬地拜了拜。
然后迅速退了出去。
与此同时。
安置区，李家小院。

李长生盘膝坐在地下密室蒲团上。
前方摆着三个储物袋，其中一个是沈公子的，另外两个是白手套的。
李长生看着眼前三个储物袋，年迈的心都不淡定了。
三个储物袋。
就相当于三个宝箱啊！
到底能够开出什么宝贝呢？
真是令人期待啊！
李长生霍霍双手，先用灵识扫视一眼，那两位白手套的储物袋。
很垃圾。
只有几块下品灵石，以及一些无用之物。
李长生非常失望。
随后……
灵识落在沈公子的储物袋上面。
目光徒然一亮。
不愧是合欢宗的弟子。
特么的！
简直是我的送财童子啊！
只见储物袋内，光是下品灵石就有三千多块，中品灵石也有五十块。
除此之外。
还有几瓶精进修为的【合气丹】。

以及三样带有特殊属性的宝物。
李长生非常高兴。有了这些资源，足够稳固眼前修为了，甚至还能更进一步。
整理完杂物。
李长生的目光落在带有特殊属性的宝物上面。
第一样，是一枚粉色的玉简。
玉简散发着淡淡的桃花香气。
随着李长生的神识探入，一股靡靡之音瞬间响起，不堪入目的画面如同幻灯片般闪过。
李长生顿时知道了玉简里面记载的东西。
《阴阳采补欢喜禅》。
这是一门极其邪恶的功法。
通过掠夺异性的精元来强行提升修为。
也就是所谓的【采补术】。
“这可是妥妥的邪道啊！”
“我李家走的是多子多福、堂堂正正的大道。这种损阴德、坏根基的邪术，留着也是脏手。”李长生皱了皱眉头，心念间，一把火，将玉简烧得干干净净的。
第二样，则是两块古朴的灰色玉佩。
这两块灰色的玉佩，没有灵力波动，就像是路边的顽石，丢在地上都没人捡的那种。
李长生用神识扫过时，眼睛忽然亮了。
【欺天玉佩（仿品）】。
【功效：佩戴者可隔绝神识探查，隐匿自身气息、修为、体质，非金丹期大修不可看破。】
“好宝贝！”

“这东西比宁宁的暖玉锁灵佩效果还好。”
“而且一共是两块。”
“宁宁和安安，正好一人一块。”
李长生大喜过望。
身形一闪。
来到宁宁和安安面前。
将欺天玉佩（仿品）给儿女戴上。
随后才返回地下室，看向第三样带有特殊属性的东西。
这是一个通体漆黑、材质似纸非纸、似皮非皮的剪纸小人。上面刻满了密密麻麻的诡异符文。
【扎灵秘术（残篇）】。
这是一门旁门左道的奇术，源自上古巫族。
可以通过特殊的纸张和符文，剪出【纸人】。
注入灵力后。
纸人可以变成活物。
虽然战斗力不高，但胜在隐蔽、轻便，且与施术者心意相通。
“虽然这个是残篇。”
“但作用却非常不错。”
“用来探路、放哨、甚至是充当诱饵，简直是神技！”
李长生心念一动，当即分出神识，沉入其中，开始参悟。
扎灵秘术修炼的难点是如何给纸片附灵。

李长生的灵识比寻常修士要强。
附灵的话。
也不是很难。
李长生剪了一个纸人出来，附灵了几次之后，就附灵成功了。
李长生看着眼前的纸人。
感觉就像是身体的延伸一眼。
不但如同臂使。
而且还能事实感受到纸人的视角。
颇为神奇的。
李长生很高兴，好像找到了什么好玩的工具一样。
连续在密室中剪了一宿的纸人。
天亮的时候。
眼前已经堆着一百多个纸片人了。
李长生张开手，伸了伸懒腰，骨头啪啪作响。先是将这些战利品处理一遍，防止反向追踪，然后跟江翠萍吃完早餐之后，就出门了。
李长生一边往杜老头的家里走去，一边将昨晚剪好的纸人，随机散地面。
纸人落到地面之后，好像有了灵性一样，直立而起，双脚不断轮动，找到水沟处，或者隐蔽之处，躲藏起来。
成为李长生的眼睛。
数分钟后。
李长生来到了隔壁杜老头院子外。
杜老头因为帮自己探路。

已经死在了阵法之下。
虽然这是一场你情我愿的交易。
但李长生心始终有愧疚。
杜老头的婆娘是个没有修为的凡人，还带一对刚出生没多久的双胞胎，失去了家里的顶梁柱之后，生活也是过得非常困难。院子里时常传来妇人的哭声和孩子喊饿声。
李长生叹了口气。
能帮就帮一下吧！
心中仅有的良知要保住。
李长生走到门口，轻轻敲了一下门。
门内就传来杜老头婆娘的声音。
“谁啊？”
李长生：“是我。李老头。我来看看你们。”
杜氏也很好看，就是因为年轻丧偶，让其看起来憔悴了很多。
杜氏看到是李长生，眼中的戒备才淡了一丝，但是依旧没有完全开门。
“有什么事吗？”
李长生脸上挂起憨厚的笑容：
“我跟杜老头是朋友。”
“昨天突然想起来，杜老头之前有一些东西让我保管的。现在物归原主，里面有金币、灵石，以及一些其他生活用品。”
李长生将一个沉甸甸的布袋从门缝递进去。
当然……
这是善意的谎言。

但是此刻谎言却最能安抚人心。
杜氏也是一个忠厚老实的妇人。
如果不这样说的话，恐怕对方不会要。
“谢谢……谢谢李老头……”
杜氏闻言，眼泪再也止不住地流了下来，双手紧紧抱着那个布袋。
她作为杜老头的婆娘。
又怎么会不知道杜老头有没有存东西呢？
“行了，快进去吧。关好门窗，最近外面不太平。”李长生没有多待，说完转身就走。
content_en:
at the same time.
After applying, Xie Jian entered the inner gate of Qingyun Sect, Snake Head Peak.
After entering Snake Head Peak.
We arrived at Beishan on a familiar road.
Find a cave.
Go down the stone steps step by step.
The air around him became thicker and thicker, smelling of blood.
Skulls are inlaid on the walls, and their empty eye sockets seem to be watching every intruder.
At the end of the stone steps is a rolling pool of blood.
"Gudu..."
"Gudu..."
The blood was as viscous as pulp, with bubbles popping out from time to time, exploding, and splashing red mist. Several forest-white skeletons that have not completely melted can be vaguely seen floating in the pool.
This scene seemed very terrifying.
Xie Jian walked to the edge of the blood pool, knelt down on his knees with a "plop", and pressed his forehead against the cold and slippery stone bricks.
He spoke tremblingly:
"My lord."
"Something happened."
"Master Shen is dead."
The blood rolling in the blood pool suddenly stopped.
After a while.
A huge hand made of blood slowly came out from the center of the pool and was held in mid-air.
The hoarse voice echoed in the empty underground.
"The little brat of the Hehuan Sect will die if he dies."
"That's because he's not good at studying. It's no one else's fault."
Xuechi's voice was extremely cold.
Xie Jian: “But what will happen if the Hehuan Sect’s people investigate?”
Xuechi: "I will explain it to you."
After Xie Jian heard this, his tense nerves relaxed a little. Unexpectedly, the cold sweat on his back had already soaked into his brocade robe.
Originally, he thought that the Lord would be angry with him because of Mr. Shen's death.
After all, Shenzui is the bridge of communication with Hehuan Sect.
I didn’t expect adults to be so reasonable.
Immediately afterwards.
The big bloody hand suddenly collapsed and turned into a rain of blood, and the voice suddenly turned cold:
"But..."
"In a place like the resettlement area where there are only the old, the weak, the sick, and the disabled, you continue to destroy my manpower."
"I have to doubt your ability."
"I don't mind using another agent if you can't complete my plan."
The sound of the blood pool was as cold as hell.
When Xie Jian heard this, he couldn't help sweating profusely on his forehead and his whole body was trembling.
Bang bang bang!
Xie Jian lowered his head.
He dunked his head nine times in a row against the blood pool.
"Please give me another chance, sir."
"I will definitely finish it beautifully."
"And..."
"The resettlement area is losing manpower one after another because there are hidden masters of foundation building inside."
The first half of Xie Jian's sentence begs for mercy, and the second half is an explanation.
The blood pool rolled for a while, and suddenly a huge red eye formed in front of Xie Jian, cold and terrifying.
"I can give you one last chance."
"And I'll give you the tools you need to kill the foundation-building monks."
"If you still can't finish it in the end, you know the consequences."
Xie Jian knelt on the ground and said in an excited voice:
"Thank you, sir."
"I promise I can get it done."
"I hope so!" Xuechi said, the blood kept rolling, and then two streams of light flew out from the depths of the blood pool and floated in front of Xie Jian.
A jade slip as scarlet as blood.
A black compass engraved with ferocious faces.
"These two props."
"The jade slip has sealed a [blood evil divine light] from me, which can kill the early stage of the golden elixir. If you touch it, you will die."
"The compass is a [soul-seeking plate] that can detect the fluctuations of energy, blood and spiritual power within a three-mile radius. As long as the hidden monk has not reached the golden elixir stage, he cannot avoid detection."
"Thank you, sir."
Xie Jian stretched out his trembling hands and took the two props.
With these two trump cards.
He will then have the confidence to suppress the resettlement areas.
"No need to thank me."
"These two things are not given to you for free."
"There are two tasks."
"First: Take complete control of the settlement area. Find out the hidden rat."
"Second: I want ten pairs of boys and girls with spiritual roots."
"If it can't be done..."
"Your flesh and blood in the late stage of foundation building,Just use it to fill my blood pool. "
Xie Jian was so frightened that he kowtowed frantically. His forehead hit the ground with a muffled sound, and blood flowed out:
"My subordinates obey. "
“It will definitely happen. "
"Go away. "
After the adult in the blood pool said these words, there was silence immediately, and there was no more disturbance.
Xie Jian bowed respectfully to the blood pool.
Then quickly backed out.
At the same time.
Resettlement area, Li Family Courtyard.
Li Changsheng sat cross-legged on the futon in the underground secret room.
There are three storage bags in front, one of which belongs to Mr. Shen and the other two belong to White Gloves.
Li Changsheng looked at the three storage bags in front of him, and his old heart became uneasy.
Three storage pockets.
It’s equivalent to three treasure chests!
What kind of treasure can be found?
It’s really exciting!
Li Changsheng's hands were shaking, and he first glanced at the storage bags of the two white gloves with his spiritual consciousness.
Very rubbish.
There are only a few low-grade spiritual stones and some useless things.
Li Changsheng was very disappointed.
Then...
The spiritual consciousness fell on Mr. Shen's storage bag.
His eyes flickered in vain.
He is worthy of being a disciple of the Hehuan Sect.
What the hell!
He is simply my money-giving boy!
In the storage bag, there were more than three thousand low-grade spiritual stones alone, and there were fifty middle-grade spiritual stones.
Besides that.
There are also a few bottles of [Heqi Pill] for improving cultivation.
and three treasures with special properties.
Li Changsheng was very happy. With these resources, it is enough to stabilize the current cultivation level, and it can even go a step further.
Finished sorting out the clutter.
Li Changsheng's eyes fell on the treasure with special attributes.
The first one is a pink jade slip.
The jade slips exude a faint fragrance of peach blossoms.
As Li Changsheng's spiritual consciousness penetrated, an overwhelming sound instantly sounded, and unsightly images flashed by like a slideshow.
Li Changsheng immediately knew what was recorded in the jade slip.
"Yin Yang Collecting and Replenishing Joyful Zen".
This is an extremely evil technique.
By plundering the essence of the opposite sex to forcibly improve one's cultivation level.
This is the so-called [tonic technique].
“This is a completely evil way! "
“My Li family is following the path of having many children, many blessings, and being upright. This kind of witchcraft that damages one's moral character and destroys one's foundation is dirty if you keep it. "Li Changsheng frowned, and in his mind, a fire burned the jade slips cleanly.
The second item is two simple gray jade pendants.
These two pieces of gray jade pendants have no spiritual power fluctuations, just like stubborn stones on the roadside, the kind that no one picks up even if they are thrown on the ground.
When Li Changsheng swept across it with his spiritual consciousness, his eyes suddenly lit up.
[Deception Jade Pendant (imitation)].
[Efficacy: The wearer can isolate his spiritual consciousness from detection and hide his own aura, cultivation, and physique. It cannot be seen through unless he is in the golden elixir stage. 】
“Good baby! "
“This thing is more effective than Ning Ning’s Warm Jade Lock Spirit Pendant. "
“And there are two pieces in total. "
"Ning Ning and An An just happen to be together. "
Li Changsheng was overjoyed.
The figure flashed.
Came to Ning Ning and An An.
Give the deceiving jade pendant (imitation) to your children.
Then he returned to the basement and looked at the third thing with special properties.
This is a paper-cut figure that is completely black, made of paper but not paper, and skin but not skin. It was engraved with densely packed strange runes.
[Secret Technique of Zhaling the Spirit (Fragment)].
This is a heretical thaumaturgy, originating from the ancient witch clan.
[Paper Figures] can be cut out using special paper and runes.
After injecting spiritual power.
Paper figures can become living creatures.
Although the combat effectiveness is not high, it is better at concealment, portability, and being connected to the mind of the caster.
“Although this is a fragment. "
“But it works very well. "
"Used to explore paths, look out, or even serve as bait, it's a magical skill! "
With a thought in Li Changsheng's mind, he immediately separated his spiritual consciousness, sank into it, and began to comprehend.
The difficulty in practicing the secret technique of Zha Ling is how to give paperThe film is attached to the spirit.
Li Changsheng's spiritual consciousness is stronger than that of ordinary monks.
Words possessed by spirits.
It's not very difficult either.
Li Changsheng cut out a paper man, and after a few times of possessing the spirit, the spirit was successfully possessed.
Li Changsheng looked at the paper man in front of him.
It feels like an extension of the body.
Not only is it like an arm wielder.
And you can actually feel the perspective of the paper man.
Quite magical.
Li Changsheng was very happy, as if he had found something interesting.
A paper man who spent a whole night cutting out paper figures in a secret room.
At dawn.
There are already more than a hundred paper figures piled in front of me.
Li Changsheng opened his hands and stretched, his bones crackling. First, he processed the loot to prevent reverse tracking, and then went out after having breakfast with Jiang Cuiping.
As Li Changsheng walked towards Old Man Du's house, he randomly scattered the paper figures cut out last night on the ground.
After the paper man fell to the ground, he stood upright as if he had become spiritual. His feet kept turning, and he found a ditch or a hidden place to hide.
Become Li Changsheng’s eyes.
A few minutes later.
Li Changsheng arrived outside Old Man Du's yard next door.
Old Man Du helped him find his way.
Already died under the formation.
Although this is a willing transaction.
But Li Changsheng always felt guilty.
Old Man Du's mother-in-law was a mortal with no cultivation, and she had a pair of newborn twins. After losing the breadwinner of the family, her life was very difficult. The sound of women crying and children crying out for hunger were often heard in the yard.
Li Changsheng sighed.
Please help if you can!
The only conscience in your heart must be preserved.
Li Changsheng walked to the door and knocked gently.
Mrs. Du's voice came from inside the door.
"Who?"
Li Changsheng: "It's me. Old Man Li. I'm here to see you."
Du Shi is also very good-looking, but because she was widowed at a young age, she looks a lot more haggard.
When Du Shi saw it was Li Changsheng, the alertness in her eyes faded a little, but she still didn't open the door completely.
"What's the matter?"
Li Changsheng had a simple and honest smile on his face:
"Old Man Du and I are friends."
"I suddenly remembered yesterday that Old Man Du had asked me to keep some things. Now they are back to their original owners. They contain gold coins, spiritual stones, and some other daily necessities."
Li Changsheng handed a heavy cloth bag through the crack of the door.
Of course...
This is a white lie.
But at this moment, lies are the most comforting thing.
Mrs. Du is also a loyal and honest woman.
If you don't say so, I'm afraid the other party won't want it.
"Thank you...Thank you, Old Man Li..."
When Du Shi heard this, her tears couldn't stop flowing down, and she hugged the cloth bag tightly with both hands.
She is Old Man Du's mother-in-law.
How could he not know whether Old Man Du had saved anything?
"Okay, come in quickly. Close the doors and windows. It's not peaceful outside recently." Li Changsheng didn't stay long, turned around and left.
